label: Web Browser
description: Titan's web browser. Opens addresses in the browser the user actually has open, and reads their bookmarks and history. Any add-on that needs to show a web page should call this instead of embedding its own browser.

actions.name: open_url
actions.summary: Open a web address in the user's browser, starting it if it is not running.

url.description: The address. A bare domain gets https:// added.

new_tab.description: Open in a new tab (default) or replace the current page.

actions.name: current_page
actions.summary: Say which page the browser is showing.

actions.name: go_back
actions.summary: Go back a page in the browser.

actions.name: go_forward
actions.summary: Go forward a page in the browser.

actions.name: reload_page
actions.summary: Reload the page the browser is showing.

actions.name: bookmark_current
actions.summary: Bookmark the page the browser is showing.

actions.name: find_bookmark
actions.summary: Find a bookmark by title or address.

query.description: Title or address of the bookmark.

actions.name: search_history
actions.summary: Look through the pages the user has visited. With no query, the most recent ones.
